workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:

Tue Nov 17: 1:00 PM, 1:30 PM
Wed Nov 18: 3:00 PM, 3:30 PM

Could you please check these times against Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars and let me know which of these slots work for all four of them? Thanks.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text: Hi Brad, I've found a time that works for everyone: Thursday, November 19 at 2:30 PM. I've gone ahead and booked it in the system. Could you please send the confirmation email to the partners? Thanks for your help!

emails.body:
Dear Partners,

This email confirms the booking of our upcoming partners' meeting.

The meeting is scheduled for Thursday, November 19 at 2:30 PM Eastern.

A calendar invitation with a video link will be sent shortly.

Best regards,
Brad
